posts.title: A US bank account for everyone who isn’t American
posts.description: A teammate in Nigeria gets paid in dollars through a consumer app that only works for one corridor. We are building the same thing into CoinPay for every country we can, without ever holding anyone's money.

posts.title: I am now a button pusher
posts.description: An AI agent closed six issues, shipped three releases and fixed checkout while I clicked a CAPTCHA. The typing is gone. Knowing whether to push the button is the job now, and that comes from scar tissue.

posts.title: Post-mortem: how an attacker got a shell through our Postgres
posts.description: A leaked SSH key, a Docker port that skipped the firewall, and a lockdown that did not survive a reboot. What happened on one of our build boxes and what we changed.
